lessons.name: The Thracians
lessons.description: Bulgaria's ancient people, their gold and their tombs, with the passive and relative clauses.

multiple_choice.name: Match the archaeology words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The Thracians lived here
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Траките са __ по нашите земи преди хиляди години.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Траките са живели по нашите земи преди хиляди години." means "The Thracians lived in our lands thousands of years ago." Съм + the -л participle makes the present perfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Orpheus
true_false.sentence: According to legend, the singer Orpheus came from the Rhodope Mountains.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The Rhodopes are full of places named after him.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Made of pure gold
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Панагюрското съкровище е __ от чисто злато.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Панагюрското съкровище е направено от чисто злато." means "The Panagyurishte treasure is made of pure gold." Съкровище is neuter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The tomb on the UNESCO list
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Казанлъшката гробница, __ е в списъка на ЮНЕСКО, е от IV век пр. Хр.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Казанлъшката гробница, която е в списъка на ЮНЕСКО..." means "The Kazanlak tomb, which is on the UNESCO list, dates from the 4th century BC." Гробница is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Thracian writing
true_false.sentence: The Thracians wrote in the Cyrillic alphabet.
true_false.explanation: Cyrillic appeared more than a thousand years after the Thracians. They left almost no writing of their own.

multiple_choice.name: Match the discovery verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Three brothers found it
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трима братя __ съкровището случайно през 1949 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трима братя откриха съкровището случайно през 1949 година." means "Three brothers found the treasure by chance in 1949." A single past event takes the aorist.

true_false.name: True or false: Spartacus
true_false.sentence: Spartacus, who led a slave revolt against Rome, was a Thracian.
true_false.explanation: Correct. He is often claimed as a Bulgarian national symbol.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Kept in the museum
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Съкровището се __ в Националния исторически музей.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Съкровището се пази в Националния исторически музей." means "The treasure is kept in the National History Museum." Се + third person makes a passive.

lessons.name: The First Bulgarian State
lessons.description: Khans, tsars and the early capitals, with the passive and "чийто".

multiple_choice.name: Match the early history words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Founded in 681
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Българската държава е __ през 681 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Българската държава е основана през 681 година." means "The Bulgarian state was founded in 681."

true_false.name: True or false: Asparuh
true_false.sentence: Khan Asparuh is considered the founder of the Bulgarian state.
true_false.explanation: Correct. He led the Bulgars across the Danube in the 7th century.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The first capital
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Първата столица __ Плиска.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Първата столица беше Плиска." means "The first capital was Pliska."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Boris adopted Christianity
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Княз Борис I __ християнството през 864 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Княз Борис I прие християнството през 864 година." means "Prince Boris I adopted Christianity in 864."

true_false.name: True or false: Christianity date
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria adopted Christianity in the 14th century.
true_false.explanation: Bulgaria adopted Christianity in 864, in the 9th century.

multiple_choice.name: Match the royal words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whose father was Boris
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Симеон, __ баща е княз Борис, е наречен Велики.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Симеон, чийто баща е княз Борис, е наречен Велики." means "Simeon, whose father was Prince Boris, is called the Great." Чийто agrees with баща.

true_false.name: True or false: Golden Age
true_false.sentence: The reign of Tsar Simeon is called the "Golden Age" of Bulgarian culture.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literature and learning flourished in Preslav and Ohrid.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Archaeological reserves
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Днес Плиска и Преслав са археологически __ с музеи.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Днес Плиска и Преслав са археологически резервати с музеи." means "Today Pliska and Preslav are archaeological reserves with museums."

lessons.name: The Cyrillic Alphabet
lessons.description: How the alphabet was created and spread, and the letters that make it unique.

multiple_choice.name: Match the writing words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They created Glagolitic
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кирил и Методий __ глаголицата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кирил и Методий създадоха глаголицата." means "Cyril and Methodius created the Glagolitic alphabet."

true_false.name: True or false: Glagolitic
true_false.sentence: The Glagolitic alphabet was created by Cyril and Methodius.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Cyrillic came later, from their disciples in Bulgaria.

fill_in_the_blank.name: By their disciples
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кирилицата е създадена от __ на Кирил и Методий.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кирилицата е създадена от учениците на Кирил и Методий." means "Cyrillic was created by the disciples of Cyril and Methodius."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Thirty letters
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Днес българската азбука има тридесет __ на брой.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Днес българската азбука има тридесет букви на брой." means "Today the Bulgarian alphabet has thirty letters."

true_false.name: True or false: Only in Bulgaria
true_false.sentence: The Cyrillic alphabet is used only in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Cyrillic is also used in Russia, Ukraine, Serbia, North Macedonia and many other countries.

multiple_choice.name: Match sounds and letters
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each sound to its Bulgarian letter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Used by millions
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кирилицата, __ днес използват милиони хора, идва от България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кирилицата, която днес използват милиони хора, идва от България." means "Cyrillic, which millions of people use today, comes from Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: EU alphabet
true_false.sentence: In 2007 Cyrillic became the third official alphabet of the European Union.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It happened when Bulgaria joined the EU, after Latin and Greek.

fill_in_the_blank.name: How щ is read
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Буквата „щ“ се __ като „шт“.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Буквата „щ“ се чете като „шт“." means "The letter щ is read as 'sht'."

lessons.name: Ottoman Rule and the Revival
lessons.description: Five centuries of Ottoman rule, the National Revival and the fight for freedom.

multiple_choice.name: Match the Revival words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Almost five centuries
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: България __ под османска власт почти пет века.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "България беше под османска власт почти пет века." means "Bulgaria was under Ottoman rule for almost five centuries."

true_false.name: True or false: Levski
true_false.sentence: Vasil Levski is known as the "Apostle of Freedom".
true_false.explanation: Correct. He built a network of secret revolutionary committees.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Paisiy wrote his history
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Паисий Хилендарски __ „История славянобългарска“ през 1762 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Паисий Хилендарски написа „История славянобългарска“ през 1762 година." means "Paisius of Hilendar wrote his Slavonic-Bulgarian History in 1762." A finished work takes the aorist.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The uprising broke out
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Априлското въстание __ през 1876 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Априлското въстание избухна през 1876 година." means "The April Uprising broke out in 1876."

true_false.name: True or false: April Uprising
true_false.sentence: The April Uprising of 1876 won Bulgaria its freedom at once.
true_false.explanation: The uprising was crushed, but its brutal suppression turned Europe's attention to Bulgaria and led to the war of 1877-78.

multiple_choice.name: Match the community words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A place where people read
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Читалището е място, __ хората четат, учат и празнуват.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Читалището е място, където хората четат, учат и празнуват." means "A chitalishte is a place where people read, learn and celebrate."

true_false.name: True or false: Chitalishte
true_false.sentence: A "читалище" is a traditional Bulgarian community cultural centre.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Almost every town and village has one, with a library, a stage and classes.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Levski travelled the country
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Левски __ из цялата страна и създаваше революционни комитети.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Левски обикаляше из цялата страна и създаваше революционни комитети." means "Levski travelled all over the country setting up revolutionary committees." A repeated background activity takes the imperfect, like създаваше.

lessons.name: Liberation and the Third Bulgarian State
lessons.description: The war of 1877-78, the new state and its first milestones.

multiple_choice.name: Match the state words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Signed on 3 March
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Санстефанският мирен договор е __ на 3 март 1878 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Санстефанският мирен договор е подписан на 3 март 1878 година." means "The Treaty of San Stefano was signed on 3 March 1878."

true_false.name: True or false: Shipka
true_false.sentence: The battles at the Shipka Pass were a key part of the war of 1877-78.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian volunteers and Russian troops held the pass for months.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The capital was moved
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: След Освобождението столицата __ в София.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "След Освобождението столицата беше преместена в София." means "After the Liberation, the capital was moved to Sofia."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The constitution was adopted
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Търновската конституция __ приета през 1879 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Търновската конституция беше приета през 1879 година." means "The Tarnovo Constitution was adopted in 1879."

true_false.name: True or false: Independence 1878
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria declared full independence in 1878.
true_false.explanation: Full independence was declared in 1908. That is why 22 September is Independence Day.

multiple_choice.name: Match dates and events
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each year to the Bulgarian event.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Who defended Shipka
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Опълченците, __ защитаваха Шипка, са национални герои.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Опълченците, които защитаваха Шипка, са национални герои." means "The volunteers who defended Shipka are national heroes." Които is the plural form.

true_false.name: True or false: Sofia capital
true_false.sentence: Sofia has been the capital of Bulgaria since 1879.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Before that, the capital was Veliko Tarnovo.

fill_in_the_blank.name: It would have been smaller
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако не беше Съединението, днешна България __ по-малка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако не беше Съединението, днешна България щеше да бъде по-малка." means "Had it not been for the Unification, today's Bulgaria would be smaller."

lessons.name: Famous Bulgarians
lessons.description: Sportspeople, artists and inventors who made Bulgaria known.

multiple_choice.name: Match the achievers
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: He won the Ballon d'Or
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Христо Стоичков __ „Златната топка“ през 1994 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Христо Стоичков спечели „Златната топка“ през 1994 година." means "Hristo Stoichkov won the Ballon d'Or in 1994."

true_false.name: True or false: Christo
true_false.sentence: The artist Christo, famous for wrapping buildings, was born in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Correct. He was born in Gabrovo in 1935.

fill_in_the_blank.name: She set a world record
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Стефка Костадинова __ световен рекорд в скока на височина през 1987 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Стефка Костадинова постави световен рекорд в скока на височина през 1987 година." means "Stefka Kostadinova set a world high jump record in 1987." Her 2.09 m stood for 37 years.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Born in Haskovo
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Григор Димитров е тенисист, __ е роден в Хасково.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Григор Димитров е тенисист, който е роден в Хасково." means "Grigor Dimitrov is a tennis player who was born in Haskovo."

true_false.name: True or false: Stoichkov
true_false.sentence: Hristo Stoichkov is a famous Bulgarian opera singer.
true_false.explanation: Stoichkov is a footballer. A famous Bulgarian opera singer is the bass Boris Christoff.

multiple_choice.name: Match the success words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Known all over the world
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е известен __ целия свят.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е известен по целия свят." means "He is famous all over the world."

true_false.name: True or false: Atanasoff
true_false.sentence: John Atanasoff, a pioneer of the electronic computer, had a Bulgarian father.
true_false.explanation: Correct. His father came from the village of Boyadzhik.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would like to meet
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Бих искал да се __ с някой известен спортист.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бих искал да се запозная с някой известен спортист." means "I would like to meet a famous athlete."

lessons.name: Art and Museums
lessons.description: Icons, frescoes and painters, with passive participles and "чието".

multiple_choice.name: Match the art words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The exhibition will open
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изложбата ще __ открита в петък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изложбата ще бъде открита в петък." means "The exhibition will be opened on Friday." The future passive uses ще бъде.

true_false.name: True or false: Zahari Zograf
true_false.sentence: Zahari Zograf was a 19th-century painter of icons and church frescoes.
true_false.explanation: Correct. His work can be seen at the Rila, Troyan and Bachkovo monasteries.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whose real name
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Картините на Майстора, __ истинско име е Владимир Димитров, са много цветни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...Майстора, чието истинско име е Владимир Димитров..." means "...the Master, whose real name is Vladimir Dimitrov..." Чието agrees with име, which is neuter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Painted in 1259
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Стенописите в Боянската църква са __ през 1259 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Стенописите в Боянската църква са нарисувани през 1259 година." means "The frescoes in Boyana Church were painted in 1259."

true_false.name: True or false: Boyana Church
true_false.sentence: The Boyana Church is famous for its modern street art.
true_false.explanation: It is famous for its medieval frescoes and is on the UNESCO World Heritage list.

multiple_choice.name: Match the art verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I admire his talent
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Възхищавам се __ таланта му.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Възхищавам се на таланта му." means "I admire his talent." Възхищавам се takes на.

true_false.name: True or false: Ars longa
true_false.sentence: The saying "Животът е кратък, изкуството е вечно" means "Life is short, art is eternal".
true_false.explanation: Correct. It goes back to the Latin "Ars longa, vita brevis".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Icons are restored by experts
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Иконите се __ от специалисти.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Иконите се реставрират от специалисти." means "The icons are restored by specialists." Иконите is plural.

lessons.name: Music and Folklore
lessons.description: Folk instruments, odd rhythms and the voices that went to space.

multiple_choice.name: Match the instruments
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English description to the Bulgarian instrument.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Made from goatskin
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Гайдата се __ от козя кожа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гайдата се прави от козя кожа." means "The bagpipe is made from goatskin."

true_false.name: True or false: Voyager
true_false.sentence: A Bulgarian folk song was sent into space on the Voyager Golden Record in 1977.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The song was "Излел е Дельо хайдутин", sung by Valya Balkanska.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Its irregular rhythms
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Българската народна музика е известна с __ си ритми.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...е известна с неравноделните си ритми" means "...is known for its irregular rhythms." With си, the adjective takes the article.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A dance in 7/16
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ръченицата е танц, __ се играе в ритъм 7/16.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ръченицата е танц, който се играе в ритъм 7/16." means "The rachenitsa is a dance performed in 7/16 time." The relative pronoun agrees with танц.

true_false.name: True or false: Kaval
true_false.sentence: The "кавал" is a kind of drum.
true_false.explanation: The кавал is a long wooden shepherd's flute.

multiple_choice.name: Match the folklore words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Thousands of performers
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На събора в Копривщица се __ хиляди изпълнители.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На събора в Копривщица се събират хиляди изпълнители." means "Thousands of performers gather at the Koprivshtitsa folk fair."

true_false.name: True or false: Grammy
true_false.sentence: The choir "Le Mystère des Voix Bulgares" won a Grammy award.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It won in 1990 for its second album.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The horo had already begun
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато пристигнахме, хорото вече __ започнало.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато пристигнахме, хорото вече беше започнало." means "When we arrived, the horo had already begun." The earlier event takes the pluperfect.

lessons.name: Bulgarian Literature
lessons.description: Classic and modern writers, and the words for talking about books.

multiple_choice.name: Match the literature words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A novel by Vazov
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: „Под игото“ е __ от Иван Вазов.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "„Под игото“ е роман от Иван Вазов." means "Under the Yoke is a novel by Ivan Vazov."

true_false.name: True or false: Gospodinov
true_false.sentence: Georgi Gospodinov won the International Booker Prize in 2023.
true_false.explanation: Correct. He won for "Времеубежище" (Time Shelter), the first Bulgarian novel to win it.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whose poems
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Христо Ботев е поет, __ стихове учат всички ученици.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Христо Ботев е поет, чиито стихове учат всички ученици." means "Hristo Botev is a poet whose poems every pupil learns." Чиито agrees with the plural стихове.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I had more time
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ повече време, щях да прочета всички разкази на Йовков.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако имах повече време, щях да прочета всички разкази на Йовков." means "If I had more time, I would read all of Yovkov's stories."

true_false.name: True or false: Aleko Konstantinov
true_false.sentence: Aleko Konstantinov wrote only poetry.
true_false.explanation: He is famous for prose: the stories of Бай Ганьо and the travel book "До Чикаго и назад".

multiple_choice.name: Match the book words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The main character
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Главният __ в „Бай Ганьо“ е търговец, който пътува из Европа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Главният герой в „Бай Ганьо“ е търговец..." means "The main character of Bay Ganyo is a trader who travels around Europe."

true_false.name: True or false: Glava
true_false.sentence: "Глава" can mean both "head" and "chapter".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Първа глава" is the first chapter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Translated into many languages
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тази книга е __ на много езици.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тази книга е преведена на много езици." means "This book has been translated into many languages."

lessons.name: Bulgaria Today
lessons.description: The country in Europe today: economy, travel and the future.

multiple_choice.name: Match the Europe words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A member since 2007
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: България е член на Европейския съюз __ 2007 година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "България е член на Европейския съюз от 2007 година." means "Bulgaria has been a member of the EU since 2007." "Since" is от.

true_false.name: True or false: NATO
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria joined NATO in 2004.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It joined the European Union three years later.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Important for the economy
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Туризмът е важен __ икономиката.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Туризмът е важен за икономиката." means "Tourism is important for the economy."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Young people decide to return
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Все повече млади хора __ да се върнат в България.
